SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_handled
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS smartphone_sales
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Smartphones'
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY smartphone_sales DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, 
       IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_spent,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) DESC) AS spend_rank
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY spend_rank;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN payments p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
HAVING total_spent > (
    SELECT AVG(customer_total) FROM (
        SELECT SUM(amount) AS customer_total
        FROM payments
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) AS subquery
)

SELECT 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.first_name, 
    c.last_name, 
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM 
    customer c
JOIN 
    payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.first_name, 
    c.last_name
HAVING 
    SUM(p.amount) > (
        SELECT AVG(customer_total)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(amount) AS customer_total
            FROM payment
            GROUP BY customer_id
        ) AS avg_spent
    )

FROM products p

JOIN (
    SELECT category_id, MAX(price) AS max_price
    FROM products
    GROUP BY category_id
) m ON p.category_id = m.category_id AND p.price = m.max_price
